mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", path AS "path" FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{islandId} AND kind = 'island' AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{islandId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r JOIN sub s ON r.parent_id = s.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{t} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT rn.code AS "code", rn.name AS "name", d.device_type AS "deviceType", c.code AS "capability", di.ip AS "ip", di.code AS "instanceCode", drv.code AS "driverCode" FROM resource_node rn LEFT JOIN device d ON d.tenant_id = rn.tenant_id AND d.code = rn.code LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = d.capability_id LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = rn.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN driver drv ON drv.id = di.driver_id WHERE rn.tenant_id = #{t} AND rn.kind = 'device' AND rn.deleted_at IS NULL AND rn.id IN (SELECT id FROM sub) ORDER BY rn.code

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{islandId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r JOIN sub s ON r.parent_id = s.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{t} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT dev.code AS "deviceCode", rp.code AS "pointCode", rp.name AS "pointName", rp.kind::text AS "nodeKind", dp.point_kind AS "pointKind", dp.point_role AS "pointRole", dp.robot_reachable AS "robotReachable", dp.position_label AS "positionLabel", dp.slot_index AS "slotIndex", dp.grid_row AS "gridRow", dp.grid_col AS "gridCol", dp.max_stack AS "maxStack", dp.max_height_mm AS "maxHeightMm", array_to_string(dp.plate_types, ',') AS "plateTypes", dp.is_entry AS "isEntry", dp.is_exit AS "isExit", dp.is_standalone AS "isStandalone", dp.is_primary AS "isPrimary", dp.order_in_device AS "orderInDevice" FROM device_point dp JOIN resource_node rp ON rp.id = dp.point_resource_id JOIN resource_node dev ON dev.id = dp.device_resource_id WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dev.id IN (SELECT id FROM sub) ORDER BY dev.code, dp.order_in_device NULLS LAST, rp.code

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{islandId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r JOIN sub s ON r.parent_id = s.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{t} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT dev.code AS "deviceCode", rp.code AS "pointCode", dm.method AS "methodName", pm.purpose AS "purpose", pm.allocation AS "allocation", pm.scope_kind AS "scopeKind", pm.priority AS "priority" FROM position_method pm JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = pm.position_id JOIN resource_node rp ON rp.id = dp.point_resource_id JOIN resource_node dev ON dev.id = dp.device_resource_id JOIN device_method dm ON dm.id = pm.method_id WHERE pm.tenant_id = #{t} AND pm.enabled AND dev.id IN (SELECT id FROM sub) ORDER BY dev.code, rp.code, dm.method

SELECT robot.code AS "robotCode", rp.code AS "code", rp.name AS "name", rp.x AS "x", rp.y AS "y", rp.z AS "z", rp.point_type::text AS "pointType", rp.fill_status AS "fillStatus", dev.code AS "deviceCode" FROM robot_point rp JOIN resource_node robot ON robot.id = rp.robot_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dev ON dev.id = rp.device_resource_id WHERE rp.tenant_id = #{t} AND rp.island_id = #{islandId} ORDER BY robot.code, rp.code
SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM driver WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: WITH rn AS ( INSERT INTO resource_node (tenant_id, code, name, parent_id, kind, location, attr, sort_order) VALUES (#{t}, #{pointCode}, #{pointCode}, #{deviceResourceId}, CAST(#{resourceKind} AS resource_kind), jsonb_build_object('zone', #{deviceCode}, 'point', #{pointCode}), jsonb_build_object('source', 'island-import'), 0) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) DO UPDATE SET parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, updated_at = now() RETURNING id ), dp AS ( INSERT INTO device_point (tenant_id, device_resource_id, point_resource_id, point_role, robot_reachable, is_entry, is_exit, order_in_device, max_stack, max_height_mm, plate_types, position_label, point_kind, grid_row, grid_col, slot_index, is_standalone, is_primary, updated_at) SELECT #{t}, #{deviceResourceId}, rn.id, COALESCE(#{pointRole}, 'both'), COALESCE(#{robotReachable}, true), COALESCE(#{isEntry}, false), COALESCE(#{isExit}, false), -- max_stack 是 NOT NULL：导出文件里可能没这个字段（老包/手写包），给默认 1 COALESCE(#{orderInDevice}, 0), COALESCE(#{maxStack}, 1), #{maxHeightMm}, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{plateTypes}, '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE string_to_array(#{plateTypes}, ',') END, #{positionLabel}, #{pointKind}, #{gridRow}, #{gridCol}, #{slotIndex}, #{isStandalone}, #{isPrimary}, now() FROM rn ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, point_resource_id) DO UPDATE SET point_role = EXCLUDED.point_role, robot_reachable = EXCLUDED.robot_reachable, is_entry = EXCLUDED.is_entry, is_exit = EXCLUDED.is_exit, order_in_device = EXCLUDED.order_in_device, max_stack = EXCLUDED.max_stack, max_height_mm = EXCLUDED.max_height_mm, plate_types = EXCLUDED.plate_types, position_label = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.position_label, ''), device_point.position_label), point_kind = EXCLUDED.point_kind, grid_row = EXCLUDED.grid_row, grid_col = EXCLUDED.grid_col, slot_index = EXCLUDED.slot_index, is_standalone = EXCLUDED.is_standalone, is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary, updated_at = now() RETURNING point_resource_id ), ps AS ( INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, plate_id, updated_at) SELECT #{t}, dp.point_resource_id, NULL, now() FROM dp ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO NOTHING ) SELECT count(*) FROM dp

INSERT INTO robot_point (tenant_id, island_id, robot_resource_id, code, name, x, y, z, point_type, fill_status, device_resource_id) VALUES (#{t}, #{islandId}, #{robotResourceId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{x}, #{y}, #{z}, #{pointType}, #{fillStatus}, #{deviceResourceId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, robot_resource_id, code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, x = EXCLUDED.x, y = EXCLUDED.y, z = EXCLUDED.z, point_type = EXCLUDED.point_type, fill_status = EXCLUDED.fill_status, device_resource_id = EXCLUDED.device_resource_id, updated_at = now()
